findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recent_changes · Private data: get_avg_cost · Public sink: get_filing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recent_changes · Private data: get_avg_cost · Public sink: get_filing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
